name: print-social-new-year-party-posts-geometric-memphis-blue-orange-black
title: 'New Year Party' pack with big geometric numerals and Memphis-style shapes in blue, orange and black
whatItIs: Five square posts with giant stacked '2021' numerals styled from geometric shapes, Memphis-pattern accents (stripes, dots, half-circles), bold 'PARTY' and 'NEW YEAR' headlines, and event details (Club Name, DJ Name, 8PM) in cream, blue, orange and black.
whatItMeans: Festive and graphic; treating numerals as geometric compositions makes a simple date the whole design's centrepiece.
techniques: Build large numerals from simple geometric shapes.
Use Memphis-style patterns (dots, stripes) as period-appropriate texture.
Keep a consistent three-colour palette across a themed set.

vocabulary.definition: Playful geometric shapes and patterns from 1980s design.
Treating a number as a primary graphic element.
